Mentorship

Mentorship

Pairing women who have built something with women who are building now.

Find a mentor

Tell us what you’re working on and where you’re stuck. We’ll introduce you to a member whose experience fits.

Request a mentor

How it works

  1. 01

    Apply

    Share your goals and the kind of experience you’re looking for.

  2. 02

    Get introduced

    We match you personally with a mentor and make the introduction.

  3. 03

    Meet regularly

    Agree on a rhythm that works for both of you and set goals together.

Become a mentor

Share what you’ve learned.

You don’t need to have everything figured out. If you have built a career or a business and are willing to listen and be honest, you have something valuable to offer.
